probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Lyngvær Menu Lyngvær Close Overview Buy Author Rooms Offers Restaurant Surroundings Events The house Plan your stay Booking Practical info Gift vouchers Contact Get in touch [email protected] +00 00 00 00 00 On the island now Surroundings Boots, kayaks, rain gear and packed lunches are in the boathouse. Ask for them at breakfast. The island and the sound Walks from the door, kayaks on the jetty and the boat whenever the weather allows. Maren writes every guide herself. Walk All year The north point walk A loop over the heather to the north point and back along the shore, past the old fishing huts. From the door Two hours Paddle May to September Kayak to the bird skerries A sheltered paddle through the inner skerries to the rocks where puffins and sea eagles nest. Twenty minutes from the jetty Three hours Swim All year, if you dare Saltwater swim at Kvitsand A white shell sand beach on the south side, with water the colour of the Caribbean and the temperature of the Arctic. Ten minutes' walk As long as you can stand it The boat From the guest quay, every day of the year. Forty minutes through the skerries. Sandnessjøen to Lyngvær 11:00 15:30 Lyngvær to Sandnessjø
